answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil resistance comes from each identity sustaining a personal lagoon of timestamped original attestations forming an unbroken spiral of sequential dependencies across epochs. An attacker spawning many fakes must compute and store a separate spiral history for every clone in the tundra of scarce verification slots, paying linear compute and storage costs that grow with each additional identity while honest agents share the same verification pool. This makes mass duplication uneconomical as the attacker cannot amortize the spiral work.
